phases.name: Foundation
exit_criteria: Exact source revision passes offline validation and meaningful negative tests.
Actual repository, Project fields/views/items and native graph have complete verified readback; any missing remote setup requirement keeps this phase unaccepted.
Independent source review and organizational approval boundaries remain accurately recorded.

phases.name: Metadata Pilot
exit_criteria: A bounded real candidate cohort has a dated denominator and exclusion log.
Every admitted field has exact-version source, rights and editorial evidence.
Unknowns, conflicts, inaccessible sources and rejected records remain visible.

phases.name: Evidence Pilot
exit_criteria: Claim summaries preserve study context and contradictory evidence.
Any reproduction label resolves to actual independent execution receipts.
Corrections and graph provenance are verified for the selected pilot.

phases.name: Website Handoff
exit_criteria: Exact admitted snapshot and consumer revision pass actual receiving tests.
Source, rights, uncertainty and correction states remain visible in public journeys.
Website owner accepts publication and records actual deployment/readback separately.

phases.name: Maintained Index
exit_criteria: Actual stewardship, refresh, correction and recovery receipts exist.
Coverage gaps and unresolved resource/operator decisions remain transparent.
Every in-scope package has acceptance or an explicit reviewed scope change.

prohibited_shortcuts: No fabricated citations, papers, scientific findings, reproduction results or permissions.
No copied restricted article content, figures, manuscripts or private datasets.
No status reset or assignee invention from the versioned planning baseline.
No launch, live-automation or hosted-CI claim without actual execution evidence.
